title: Eye injury or chemical splash
whenToUse: Dust or a chemical splash in your eye without embedded objects or vision loss.

steps.text: Do not rub or press on your eye.
Hold the injured eye lower so water does not reach the other eye.
Flush gently with plenty of clean water for 15 minutes.
steps.detail: Continue flushing the full 15 minutes to wash away any chemical residue.

steps.text: If an object is stuck in your eye, cover loosely with a rigid cup.
steps.caution: Never try to pull out an embedded object.

redFlags: You have sudden blurred vision or vision loss.
An object is stuck in your eye.

escalation.text: Red flag or getting worse? Alert a crewmate now. Do not wait for Earth.
